'''Stoneheart''' was an [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]] that was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was installed on an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] and designed to analyze enemy tactics and counter them. Eventually, Stoneheart outlived its usefulness and was shut down.<ref name="Game" />

Stoneheart was accidentally reactivated and deployed it [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], learning of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Staying true to the tenets of the Republic, Stoneheart installed itself in an old [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[Candor Six Six Twelve]] and made its way to [[Ord Mynock Freeport]] seeking to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Game" />
